question: Will Marc Pubill Pages (Atlético Madrid) get a yellow card vs Bayern München on Nov 3, 2026 (reg. + stoppage time only)?

- "No": Wins if Marc Pubill Pages (Atlético Madrid) receives no yellow card during regulation time or stoppage time (excluding extra time and penalty shootout) of the same match within the same window, including if he does not appear in the match at all.

Clarifications:

- If Marc Pubill Pages does not feature in the match (not in the starting XI and not used as a substitute), "No" wins.
